brief: One persistent lobby world independent of chosen map. Retain five floating bot holograms and three shootable horseshoe magnets. Three different spatial identities and destination devices; v1 retained.

jobs.name: Counterweight
jobs.idea: A weighted stone window shows the next map. The room, sky and light stay fixed; only the view and destination label change.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW ORIGINAL full lobby concept, not a variation of a fantasy courtyard. Same near-square1386x1294 frame and steep58degree top-down three-quarter CAMERA as reference1. Reference1 is ONLY camera, UI positions, translucent bots and horseshoe difficulty targets. Reference2 is ONLY Moebius thin navy line, aquarelle palette, quiet sky and heavy primitive-buildable materials. Reference3 is painted UI material. Lobby is its own home, IDENTICAL world and lighting regardless of selected map; ONLY the single specified destination device changes content. Do not make the home day versus night according to map.
Distinctive art: immense emptiness, unexpectedly big utilitarian stone/ceramic forms, odd purposeful mechanisms, offbeat playable magic rather than stock medieval fantasy. Thin deliberate navy silhouette lines, spare underside hatching, broad muted warm paper/stone surfaces, quiet aqua/lilac recesses, printed soft shadows; lineLESS open floor with subtle paper grain only. Small angular tough playful heroes, asymmetrical worn enamel/clay helmets and planted shape, no hoods or ranger/knight outfits, no glossy eyes or blush. Three.js practical slabs, simple curved strips, cylinders and polygons. No castle ruins, gothic arches, carved runes, banners on plinths, rune stones, swords, tavern, wood training dummies, vegetation carpet, picturesque generic cliffs, neon technology or cyberpunk. This is a strange physical home to an action brawler, not a generic Steam RPG.
FUNCTIONS (all visible; don't overcrowd):
Six low FLUSH seat plates on floor, EXACTLY3blue and3red. One selected solid slim angular hero with3quiver rods occupies one blue plate. Five bot silhouettes float about0.2m ABOVE the other five plates: EXACTLY2blue and3red translucent HOLOGRAMS, genuinely see-through bodies (floor shows through), tiny horizontal ink scan lines or broken contours, no glass capsule, no neon beams, no thick bloom. They have readable rough helmet/glove/racket shapes, quiet sharp personality. No team banner or flag anywhere. Small blue/red plate accents carry ownership. Floor reserved for walking.
Two central sparring targets stand/float on little foot points: asymmetric chunky porcelain dummy effigies, one low square 'mitt', one thin oval 'quiver', segmented weight and visible hit plate, no wooden humanoid scarecrow, round knight shield or fantasy statue.
Three separate physically SHOOTABLE HORSESHOE MAGNETS in front row: clear upright U silhouettes open at top, sculptural weathered ferrite/stone and blunt ivory pole faces, thick weighty crooked arms. Easy has one broad simple U yoke, Normal same U with2stacked lamination ribs, Hard same U with3thick ribs. All recognizable magnets, neutral graphite/stone/olive/lilac, not colourful smiling cartoon characters or cute green/orange/pink magnet cutouts. NO red/blue terminals; no runes. Ground labels EXACTLY "EASY", "NORMAL", "HARD" underneath. Small grounded bases and enough space to shoot or walk up.
One distinct physically reachable READY/START floor zone with a simple inset step or light pool and exact small label "READY", near destination device but outside seats.
UI: four small vertically stacked painted cream PAPER hero cards down far LEFT, single wobbly ink rims, faint mineral washes, uppercase names EXACTLY "FLETCHER","MITTS","CAROM","SKIP". Replace generic RPG portraits with bold simple ink emblems: quiver with3arrows; heavy five-finger mitt; oval racket; megaphone. No stripes, no solid bottom ink bar, no hard bevel or elaborate interface panels. Top-left tiny back and "PLAY ONLINE" painted chips; top-right sound and fullscreen chips; bottom-centre Q W E paper chips. Modest UI scale like screenshot. No giant title text. A small painted destination label clearly names the selected map; ONLY destination device shows map palette.
Composition: island/platform fills most of frame with a broad empty floor, functional objects readable and separated, foreground underside visible, extremely sparse backdrop seen above and at corners. Palette mostly neutral chalk, dusty grey green and lilac, saturations ONLY team units/plates blue/red and an optional tiny gold Ball. Map miniature/view may use subdued scene colours. Keep all six plates and five holograms countable; don't mistake bots for solid statues.
CONCEPT1: COUNTERWEIGHT. A radically spare, rectangular chalk-grey stone ROOM WITHOUT A ROOF, suspended in an almost WHITE CLOUDLESS PEACH VOID. Heavy low plain slate sidewalls, blunt mineral ledges, one enormous square stone WINDOW cut into an off-centre upright wall at BACK-RIGHT. NO medieval arch: a clean rectangular hole in a huge flat chamfered block, balanced by an oversized cylindrical black-grey counterweight hanging on a simple line outside one edge. Only a few hairline strata on underside. The window has a real recognizable miniature view through it: grass-topped floating pillars, white waterfall ribbons and pale peach sky of OVERTHROW. A small painted paper tag directly under window reads "NEXT: OVERTHROW". The home surrounding window remains pale neutral, no forests, moon or waterfalls elsewhere. Select Flagfall and ONLY the window view would show violet garden night; world does not rebuild. READY is a flat offset pale step at window foot, not gate. Six seat plates in two opposing COLUMN ROWS around a quiet central sparring gap, three per side like source screenshot; magnets front row. Deep magnetic clamp construction, heavy black ink underedges, no ornament. Atmosphere of an abandoned cosmic weigh station still used for play, eccentric purposeful objects and vast white space.

jobs.name: Pocket weather
jobs.idea: A small turning diorama in a ceramic weather bowl previews the next map. Only the bowl’s miniature, sky cap and label change.

CONCEPT2: POCKET WEATHER. Entire home is ONE MASSIVE OFF-WHITE CERAMIC SAUCER floating in a quiet dusty mint-grey empty sky, huge thick curved rim and aubergine underside. Wide plain flat circular floor, no fantasy architecture, no garden outside. Two giant weathered ferrite U CRADLES hug opposite outside rim edges (not difficulty targets; outside playable space), like huge magnetic pottery handles, asymmetrical heft and glaze worn only at corners. Camera remains steep screenshot angle; circular saucer/elliptical outline visibly DIFFERENT from rectangular room.
At BACK-RIGHT sits one low broad ceramic WEATHER BOWL containing a small turning PHYSICAL DIORAMA OF FLAGFALL: two paths across a lilac floating platform, a few deep-teal leaf fans, two little orchid bells, and a small dark-violet hemisphere/sky disc behind miniature. Clearly a miniature inside a bowl, not a portal into full-size level, not an enormous screen. Small paper label "NEXT: FLAGFALL" on bowl front. Only mini stage/sky disc changes to day Overthrow when selected; neutral home remains same saucer and mint air. READY is pale floor oval at bowl front, no arch.
Six seat plates arranged as two opposing gentle ARCS,3blue at left and3red at right, clear gap for effigy targets between arcs. One solid hero plus5see-through floating bots. Three heavy upright difficulty horseshoe magnets at FRONT, U silhouette open upwards. Composition airy, counterintuitive magical appliance rather than temple; basin and thick cup forms are simple geometry, no circuit boards, logos, ornamental radial runes or decorative plaques.

CONCEPT3: PRINTYARD. A huge FOLDED SHEET OF STONE serves as the training floor: pale heavy slab, one outer edge folds UP into a blunt tall creased wall at back-left, the front/right edge folds DOWN as a thick angular overhang. It looks like impossible mineral origami with broad straight planes and inked fold silhouettes, NOT medieval ruins or literal lightweight paper floating stage. Quiet dusty rose-grey empty sky beyond with just2thin clouds, no lush floating island panorama. All walking floor remains large flat lineless pale grey-green. The weight shows in a 1m thick squared cut edge and printed dark wedge shadow.
One GIANT SIMPLE GRAPHITE/STONE PRINT ROLLER sits on blunt supports at BACK-RIGHT OUTER EDGE. A long wide DECKLED PAPER SHEET unwinds vertically from the roller outside the platform edge but faces camera: it carries a striking flat ink-and-watercolour MAP PICTURE, clearly bright floating day pillars/waterfalls and the ONE broad lane of OVERTHROW. It is a tangible oversized map print, NO magic glowing portal or electronic screen. Small exact title at print top "NEXT: OVERTHROW". Changing chosen map replaces paper picture with TWO-lane violet night garden Flagfall, nothing else changes in home. READY is a quiet rectangular stamped floor patch beside roller, small "READY", no fantasy gate.
Six seat plates form two offset SHORT ROWS3blue and3red across middle court, floating translucent bot figures visible and ONE solid selected hero; enough separation to count both teams. Two lopsided porcelain sparring effigies in central-rear open area. Difficulty magnets front row are hefty stained ferrite U YOKES with worn ivory faces and rib count1/2/3; they echo the roller weights, not carved symbols. Hero cards look like small printed/painted deckled cards in left strip, emblems not RPG portraits. Strange matter-of-fact cosmic printing workshop for players, austere playful tactility, no steampunk gears, smoke pipes, industrial neon or clutter.
